resolution: A/B agreed on braille (byte-for-byte) and on every substantive field of print.blocks (down to the italicised 'forget'); only illustrates.quote differed in style (both just repeated the sample's own title, not an actual rule quote — replaced here with 14.5.1's own actual rule text, matching every other sample's convention).
